grid_sampler.purpose: a model-free reading of coloured grids and heat maps (grid_colors.py): locate the coloured rows, sample each cell centre, name the colour; every cell carries its pixel coordinates
grid_sampler.hu_supplementary_fig_11a: 13 x 21 heat map at 4x render (cells 47.7 x 40.8 px): the red / blue / untested class agrees with the manual reading on all 273 cells, including LC96 pemetrexed+cisplatin, LC97 gemcitabine+cisplatin and LC137 etoposide+cisplatin, which the model reader read as untested
grid_sampler.dai_figure_5P: 22 x 4 grid at 12.4 x 19.5 px per cell: all 88 cells read; tumoroid response against patient response gives 19/22 with mismatches P01, P12, P36, exactly the cells marked No and the published 86.36%
grid_sampler.cost: no model call; under one second per figure
grid_sampler.agent_tool: read_grid in the agent loop: the agent names the file, page, grid box, rows and columns; every cell becomes a grid/<reading>/R<row>C<col> reference with its colour name, RGB and pixel position, and the agent receives an image marking each sample point. Values are written only by the tool; the sandboxed Python cannot write them.

round5.note: Round 5 runs the round-4 strong agent unchanged on the external cohort frozen in experiment_v2.json (external).
